articles.title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Posts Record Quarter as AI Infrastructure Demand Soars

articles.title: U.S. Jobless Claims Rise to 225,000, Marking Four-Month High Amid Labor Market Resilience
articles.excerpt: U.S. jobless claims rose to 225,000 for the week ending May 30, the highest since February, but layoffs remain historically low.

articles.title: Geopolitical Risks End AI-Fueled Rally Across Global Stock Markets
